compiled_state.title: As CI, I want a calibration-rollup workflow that runs mutation-append and churn-append on PR merge and monthly + quarterly on cron, fails loud on missing tracking tickets or aggregator errors, so that scheduled program-health rollups are reliable.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Creates .github/workflows/calibration-rollup.yml. The workflow runs mutation-append + churn-append on PR-merge events (invoking the per-PR append safeguard from the mutation-append story) and runs monthly + quarterly on cron triggers using a single declared UTC timezone that matches the aggregation logic. Includes a CI dry-run step that posts the expected comment shape to a test ticket and asserts the shape matches. The workflow exits non-zero (CI failure, not silent skip) when calibration-report.sh fails or when a target tracking ticket is missing. Also wires the M2 release-gate local invocation of the fixture-driven correctness test from sc-4.

## Done Definitions

- calibration-rollup.yml runs mutation-append and churn-append on PR-merge events ← Satisfies: sc-6
- calibration-rollup.yml runs monthly and quarterly on cron triggers using a single declared UTC timezone matching calibration-report.sh's bucket boundaries ← Satisfies: sc-6
- calibration-rollup.yml CI dry-run posts the expected comment shape to a test ticket and asserts the shape matches ← Satisfies: sc-6
- calibration-rollup.yml exits non-zero (CI failure, not silent skip) when calibration-report.sh fails or when a target tracking ticket (calibration-program-health, mutation-history, suite-churn-history) is missing ← Satisfies: sc-6
- The fixture-driven correctness test from sc-4 runs in CI via calibration-rollup.yml before any append step and is also invoked as part of the M2 release gate locally ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations

- [Reliability] The 'missing tracking ticket' failure mode is one of the surviving Red/Blue scenarios — make the error message name which ticket is missing and how to create it (run dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh), so the failure is actionable.
- [Reliability] Use the same timezone constant from the monthly/quarterly story — do not redeclare UTC in the workflow file; instead source it from the script's --print-timezone helper or equivalent, so the two cannot drift.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked
